ctaHeading: Give Your Preston Bathroom a Fresh Look
aboutText: Bath Resurfacing Melbourne has been serving Preston and the greater Melbourne area for years, specialising in high-quality bathroom resurfacing. Our skilled team uses advanced techniques to restore bathtubs, tiles, and vanities to their former glory. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional results with minimal downtime for homeowners and businesses alike.
servicesText: From bathtub refinishing to complete tile resurfacing, we offer comprehensive solutions to refresh your bathroom. Our services are designed to be cost-effective and efficient, ensuring a stunning finish without the need for full replacement.

services.title: Bathtub Resurfacing
services.desc: We restore your bathtub to like-new condition, removing chips and stains for a smooth, glossy finish.

services.title: Tile Resurfacing
services.desc: Our tile resurfacing service covers walls and floors, providing a fresh coat that revitalises your bathroom aesthetics.

services.title: Shower Tray Resurfacing
services.desc: We repair and resurface shower trays to prevent leaks and improve the overall look of your shower area.

services.title: Vanity Resurfacing
services.desc: Transform your vanity with our resurfacing process, giving it a modern and durable surface without replacement.

services.title: Sink Resurfacing
services.desc: Our sink resurfacing removes scratches and discolouration, restoring a clean and hygienic basin.

services.title: General Bathroom Resurfacing
services.desc: We handle all aspects of bathroom resurfacing, from fixtures to surfaces, ensuring a cohesive and refreshed space.
